TITLE: IMPS (Immediate Payment Service)
INTRO_1: IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) is an instant interbank electronic fund transfer service that enables customers to send and receive money in real time.
INTRO_2: IMPS is available 24x7 throughout the year, including Sundays and bank holidays.
REAL_TIME: Real-time fund transfer with immediate credit to the beneficiary account.
INSTANT_CREDIT: Funds are credited instantly to the receiver’s bank account.
MAX_LIMIT: The maximum limit for IMPS transactions is INR 5 Lakh.
